boards.title: What the Campus Tour Skips: 10 Places Students Share With Each Other
boards.description: Ten named RPI spaces with documented uses for studying, making, rehearsing, performing, and student programming.

cards.title: Folsom Library
cards.subtitle: 110 8th Street
cards.notes: Head to the upper floors for perimeter seating, or use an unlocked small group room when available; reservable rooms support planned group work.
cards.short_summary: A library building with open seating and both drop-in and reservable group-study options.
cards.evidence_claim: Folsom Library provides more than 500 open seats and has unlocked first-come group rooms plus reservable group study rooms.
cards.source_title: Meeting and Study Spaces | Rensselaer Libraries
cards.access_notes: Visitors without a campus card must first stop at the Service Desk; room availability varies.

cards.title: Architecture Library
cards.subtitle: Greene Building, Room 308
cards.notes: Use this smaller library when your work benefits from architecture-focused collections, public computers, scanners, and a distinct place to settle in.
cards.short_summary: RPI’s architecture library combines study access with computers and scanning equipment.
cards.evidence_claim: The Architecture Library has public computers, scanners, and Wi-Fi for RPI-affiliated patrons using their laptops.
cards.source_title: Computers, Printers and Scanners | Rensselaer Libraries
cards.access_notes: Located in Greene Building 308; library services and equipment use follow RPI Libraries policies.

cards.title: Rensselaer Student Union
cards.subtitle: Corner of Sage Avenue and 15th Street
cards.notes: Use the building as a practical meet-up point for a study session, a special event, or a club connection; check room schedules first.
cards.short_summary: A student-centered building with meeting rooms, dining, businesses, social spaces, and events.
cards.evidence_claim: The Rensselaer Student Union contains meeting rooms, businesses, dining, and social spaces, and is a place to study and attend special events.
cards.access_notes: Use of rooms and facilities is subject to Union scheduling and access policies.

cards.title: McNeil Room
cards.subtitle: Rensselaer Student Union
cards.notes: Between meals and programs, bring coursework to the McNeil Room; it serves as a student study space as well as a multipurpose event room.
cards.short_summary: A Union room that shifts between dining, student programming, and study use.
cards.evidence_claim: The McNeil Room is a dining facility and multipurpose programming space that also serves as a study space for many students around the clock.
cards.access_notes: Programming and dining activity can affect available seating; no purchase is required to use it as a study space.

cards.entity_name: Curtis R. Priem Experimental Media and Performing Arts Center
cards.title: EMPAC Common Spaces
cards.subtitle: Levels 5 and 6, 50 8th Street
cards.notes: Bring your own work or food and use the level 5–6 common spaces for a daytime study or gathering stop near EMPAC’s studios and venues.
cards.short_summary: Daytime common spaces in RPI’s media and performing-arts center.
cards.evidence_claim: EMPAC welcomes people to study and gather in its level 5 and 6 common spaces Monday through Friday, 9 a.m.–5 p.m.
cards.source_title: Students at EMPAC | Experimental Media and Performing Arts Center
cards.access_notes: Common spaces are listed as open Monday–Friday, 9 a.m.–5 p.m.; bring-your-own food and drink is permitted outside café service.

cards.title: RPI Playhouse
cards.subtitle: 15th Street
cards.notes: Look for a student production or connect with a participating performing-arts group; the venue supports student-run theatre and related organizations.
cards.short_summary: A Union facility for student-run theatre and other campus performing-arts groups.
cards.evidence_claim: The RPI Playhouse is home to performing arts and student-run theatre at Rensselaer, with the RPI Players and other groups using it.
cards.access_notes: Event attendance and space reservations depend on the production schedule and Playhouse approval process.

cards.title: J Building Music Suite
cards.subtitle: RPI J Building
cards.notes: If you are involved with RPI music groups, ask the Rensselaer Music Association about the student-use practice rooms and instrument storage.
cards.short_summary: A student music facility maintained by RPI’s music association.
cards.evidence_claim: The J Building Music Suite has practice rooms and instrument storage facilities available for student use.
cards.access_notes: Student use is administered by the Rensselaer Music Association; contact the organization for current access details.

cards.title: Academy Hall Dance Studio
cards.subtitle: Basement of Academy Hall
cards.notes: Follow RPI Ballroom’s schedule for lessons, practices, or a social dance; the studio is a concrete place to join a partner-free introductory activity.
cards.short_summary: A campus dance studio used for RPI Ballroom lessons, practices, and social events.
cards.evidence_claim: RPI Ballroom holds club and team lessons and open practices in its studio in the basement of Academy Hall.
cards.access_notes: Access is event- and organization-specific; RPI Ballroom posts its current lesson and practice schedule online.

cards.title: Mueller Center
cards.subtitle: RPI campus recreation facility
cards.notes: Check the recreation schedule or a club listing before going; the building includes fitness, weight-training, wellness, and studio activity managed by the Union.
cards.short_summary: A Rensselaer Union recreation facility supporting fitness, wellness, and dance activity.
cards.evidence_claim: The Rensselaer Union manages fitness and weight-training facilities and wellness programs at the Mueller Center; RPI Dance Club classes use its upstairs studios.
cards.access_notes: Facility and studio access depend on recreation operations and scheduled club classes.

cards.title: ’87 Gym Modeling Room
cards.subtitle: ’87 Gym, RPI campus
cards.notes: Visit during the Rensselaer Model Railroad Society’s listed meeting time to see a student club’s hands-on modeling work and ask about joining.
cards.short_summary: A named room in the ’87 Gym where RPI’s model railroad club meets.
cards.evidence_claim: The Rensselaer Model Railroad Society meets in its modeling room in the ’87 Gym and is open to all students.
cards.access_notes: The club lists Tuesday evening meetings; contact the organization to confirm access or activity before visiting.
